eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 11:54 AM on AUG 17, 2021 Effective until 9:54 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Phoenix Police Department is looking for Manuel Carreon Aguilar, 82 years old, 5 foot 6 inches tall, 170 pounds, balding gray hair and brown eyes.  Manuel was last seen wearing a blue button up shirt, blue jeans, brown boots and a camouflage Arkansas Razorback baseball hat. Manual was last seen in the area of North Cave Creek Road and East Bell Road. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
